method.baseline: Recorded same-native-binary runs from the preceding benchmarks; baseline source differs only in trajectory.py and transition.py.
method.validation: For every mode/seed, candidate counts, failed evaluations, completed iterations, timeout status and selected action/pose/reward match its pre-optimization run exactly.

profile.note: Search-only wall timers; inclusive values overlap. Exclusive values subtract instrumented child calls; native calls include immediate return handling, not pure kernel time.
